channel.title: Prism Inspector
channel.description: Updates for Prism Inspector, the macOS companion for PrismKit.

item.description:
⚠️ Breaking changes

  • sdk: compile all instrumentation out of release builds (fbc9aa1)
  • sdk: keep the stream listener out of iOS consumer binaries (db569e5)
  • split the PrismKit package out into its own repository (6f77147)
  • depend on the published PrismKit package instead of a sibling checkout (79a10e9)
  • relicense the app under MIT and point updates at GitHub Releases (198dcb8)

Features

  • PrismKit SDK, Prism Inspector companion and MCP server (fa59328)
  • app: surface the MCP server setup in Settings and Help (9ad0eac)
  • mcp: compare a rendered screen against a design (9f2a352)
  • app: draw design-check findings on the canvas (16e5f05)
  • app: update itself through Sparkle (75a606a)
  • app: ship the MCP server inside the app bundle (df99e9e)
  • release: publish to the public repository and GitHub Pages (43051b5)
  • release: derive the version from the commits (476ac69)

Fixes

  • judge spacing against the team's scale, not a hardcoded one (5f73324)
  • scripts: locate Sparkle's tools instead of assuming a DerivedData path (0a4e467)
  • scripts: make sparkle-key.sh executable (937724e)
  • release: ignore the public repository checkout (5bfbb3e)
  • release: sign with Developer ID from the archive onwards (7f14f42)

Other changes

  • license: MIT for the package, proprietary for the companion (bbc980f)
  • app: sign and notarize for Developer ID distribution (c33a03b)
  • add a manual release workflow with generated notes (1e7c7f2)
  • point the PrismKit links at the published repository (a2f03df)
  • keep signing material out of the repository (f34f351)
  • free to use, source stays closed (3325241)
  • take ownership of the analysis layer and the MCP server (d1aadcd)
  • depend on the published SDK instead of a sibling checkout (1fa5f8e)
